80 by 29 = 2320

9 * 11

80 * 9 = 720, 2x for half bit shift = 1440 dots per row
11 * 29 = 319 lines


15.625khz * 1440 = 22.5Mhz pixle clock


15.625khz * 1536 = 24Mhz
1536 - 1440 = 96, 96/9 = 10.66


CPU clock 125Mhz / 5 = 24Mhz

Goal
Make screen 5 + 80 + 5.66 chars wide
Screen 625 - 319 = 306 (153 + 319 + 153)
